items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: He says, “Come on over here and sit down.” And we sat down and had some lunch together.

ctx.x: Okay. There’s a restaurant across the street. It’s on Vine Street in Hollywood. And I went to the union one day, for whatever, either to pick up some checks or pay my dues or something. And I walked across the street to have a bite to eat in this restaurant. I walk in and I heard somebody say, “There’s the Count.” And I turned around and I looked, and it’s Count Basie. And you know, you could have knocked me over. I said, “You’re calling me the count?” He says, “Yup, you’re the Count.” I did an about face man.…
